newsitem.title: USA: Golden Star raises $22.69 mln from offering.
newsitem.headline: Golden Star raises $22.69 mln from offering.

text.p: Golden Star Resources Ltd said Thursday that three institutional purchasers have agreed to purchase a total of 3.025 million common shares of Golden Star at $7.50 each, for total proceeds of $22.69 million.

The net proceeds of this offering, said the company, will be used to fund exploration and development of Golden Star's gold and diamond projects in South America and Africa and for working capital and general corporate purposes, including potential property acquisition and development opportunities.

Golden Star Resources is a gold and diamond exploration company which holds a 30 percent common share equity interest in the Omai Mine in Guyana. It also holds significant gold and diamond exploration interests in South America and Africa.
